description: KNa₄Cl₅ is Caswellsilverite-like structured and crystallizes in the orthorhombic Immm space group. K is bonded to six Cl atoms to form KCl₆ octahedra that share corners with two equivalent KCl₆ octahedra, corners with four equivalent NaCl₆ octahedra, edges with two equivalent KCl₆ octahedra, and edges with ten NaCl₆ octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 0-5°. There are two shorter (2.91 Å) and four longer (3.04 Å) K-Cl bond lengths. There are two inequivalent Na sites. In the first Na site, Na is bonded to six Cl atoms to form NaCl₆ octahedra that share corners with six NaCl₆ octahedra, edges with four equivalent KCl₆ octahedra, and edges with eight NaCl₆ octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 0-7°. There are two shorter (2.80 Å) and four longer (2.91 Å) Na-Cl bond lengths. In the second Na site, Na is bonded to six Cl atoms to form NaCl₆ octahedra that share corners with two equivalent KCl₆ octahedra, corners with four NaCl₆ octahedra,  an edgeedge with one KCl₆ octahedra, and edges with eleven NaCl₆ octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 0-5°. There are a spread of Na-Cl bond distances ranging from 2.76-2.91 Å. There are three inequivalent Cl sites. In the first Cl site, Cl is bonded to two equivalent K and four Na atoms to form a mixture of corner and edge-sharing ClK₂Na₄ octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 0-7°. In the second Cl site, Cl is bonded to six Na atoms to form a mixture of corner and edge-sharing ClNa₆ octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 1-5°. In the third Cl site, Cl is bonded to two equivalent K and four equivalent Na atoms to form ClK₂Na₄ octahedra that share corners with six ClNa₆ octahedra and edges with twelve ClK₂Na₄ octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 0-2°.
